2_handed_kettlebell_swing: Stand with feet wider than your hips, holding the kettlebell with both hands.
Push your hips back, then snap them forward to swing the weight up to chest height.
Let it swing back between your legs and repeat; the power comes from your hips, not your arms.
barbell_ab_rollout: Kneel on the floor and hold a loaded barbell with both hands under your shoulders.
Roll the bar forward slowly, keeping your back flat and belly tight.
Go as far as you can control, then pull back to the start using your stomach.
cable_woodchoppers: Stand sideways to a cable machine and hold the handle with both hands up high.
Pull it down and across your body to the opposite hip, turning your chest.
Return slowly. Keep your arms long; your waist does the turning.
crunches: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat, hands lightly behind your head.
Curl your shoulders off the floor by tightening your stomach, not pulling your neck.
crunches_on_machine: Sit in the crunch machine and hold the handles, feet secured.
Curl your chest down towards your knees using your stomach.
Come back up slowly without letting the weights crash.
crunches_with_cable: Kneel in front of a high cable holding the rope beside your head.
Curl your back and bring your elbows towards your knees.
Return slowly. Your hips stay still; only your upper body bends.
crunches_with_legs_up: Lie on your back with legs raised, knees bent at a right angle.
Lift your shoulders off the floor by tightening your stomach.
Lower slowly, keeping your legs still in the air.
deadbug: Lie on your back with arms pointing up and knees bent over your hips.
Slowly lower one arm behind you and the opposite leg towards the floor.
Come back and switch sides. Keep your lower back pressed into the floor.
flutter_kicks: Lie on your back, hands under your hips, legs straight.
Lift your legs a little off the floor.
Kick them up and down in small quick movements, like swimming. Keep your lower back down.
full_sit_outs: Start on hands and toes, as if at the top of a push-up.
Lift one hand, turn your body and slide the opposite leg through underneath you.
Come back to the centre and repeat to the other side.
hanging_leg_raises: Hang from a pull-up bar with straight arms.
Lift your legs in front of you by tightening your stomach.
hollow_hold: Lie on your back and press your lower back into the floor.
Lift your shoulders and straight legs slightly off the floor, arms reaching forward.
Hold the banana shape, breathing calmly.
incline_plank_with_alternate_floor_touch: Hold a plank with your hands on a bench or step.
Take one hand off and touch the floor beside you.
Put it back and switch hands, keeping your body straight.
l_hold: Sit on the floor or between two supports with your hands beside your hips.
Push down to lift your body, legs straight out in front.
Hold the L shape as long as you can.
leg_raises_lying: Lie on your back with legs straight and hands under your hips.
Lift both legs up until they point to the ceiling.
Lower them slowly without touching the floor.
leg_raises_standing: Stand tall, holding onto something for balance if needed.
Lift one straight leg in front of you as high as is comfortable.
Lower it slowly and switch legs.
negative_crunches: Sit with knees bent and lean back slowly from an upright position.
Lower your upper body as slowly as you can.
Use your hands to help yourself back up and repeat.
overhand_cable_curl: Stand facing a low cable, holding the bar with palms facing down.
Bend your elbows to lift the bar to your chest, upper arms still.
plank: Rest on your forearms and toes, elbows under your shoulders.
Keep your body straight from head to heels; don't let your hips sag.
reverse_plank: Sit with legs straight and hands behind you on the floor.
Push your hips up until your body is a straight line, facing the ceiling.
roman_chair: Lie back on the Roman chair with your feet hooked in.
Curl back up using your stomach.
scissors: Lie on your back with legs straight and slightly off the floor.
Cross one leg over the other, then switch, like scissors.
Keep it slow and keep your lower back on the floor.
side_crunch: Lie on your side with knees slightly bent.
Lift your upper body sideways towards your hip.
side_plank: Lie on your side, resting on one forearm, feet stacked.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line.
sit_ups: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat on the floor.
Sit all the way up using your stomach.
splinter_sit_ups: Lie on your back with legs straight.
Sit up while twisting, bringing one knee towards the opposite elbow.
Lower and repeat to the other side.
trunk_rotation_with_cable: Sit or stand sideways to a cable, holding the handle at chest height.
Turn your upper body away from the machine.
Return slowly. Only your torso turns.
turkish_get_up: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell straight up in one hand.
Stand up step by step, always keeping the weight above you.
Reverse the steps back to the floor. Start very light.
axe_hold: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Lift your arms straight out to the sides.
Hold as long as you can, then lower slowly.
barbell_triceps_extension: Hold a barbell above your head with straight arms.
Bend only your elbows to lower it behind your head.
biceps_curl_with_cable: Stand facing a low cable, holding the bar palms up.
Bend your elbows to lift the bar to your shoulders.
Lower slowly. Your upper arms stay still.
biceps_curls_with_barbell: Stand holding a barbell with palms facing forward.
Bend your elbows to lift the bar to your shoulders.
Lower slowly without swinging your body.
biceps_curls_with_dumbbell: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, palms forward.
Bend your elbows to bring the weights up to your shoulders.
Lower slowly. Keep your elbows at your sides.
biceps_curls_with_sz_bar: Hold the zigzag bar on its angled grips, palms up.
Bend your elbows to lift it to your shoulders.
body_ups: Start in a plank on your forearms.
Push up onto your hands, one arm at a time.
Lower back to your forearms and repeat.
close_grip_bench_press: Lie on a bench and hold the bar with hands shoulder-width apart.
Lower it to your chest, elbows close to your sides.
Push it back up. This works your triceps.
curl_su_panca_a_45: Sit on a bench tilted at 45° with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging.
Bend your elbows to lift the weights.
Lower slowly all the way down.
deadhang: Grab a pull-up bar with both hands.
Hang with straight arms and relaxed body.
Hold as long as you can.
dips_between_two_benches: Put your hands on one bench behind you and your feet on another.
Bend your elbows to lower your hips.
Push back up with your arms.
dumbbell_concentration_curl: Sit and rest your elbow against the inside of your thigh, dumbbell hanging.
Bend your elbow to lift the weight towards your shoulder.
dumbbell_incline_curl: Sit on an inclined bench with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging back.
Bend your elbows to lift the weights.
dumbbell_triceps_extension: Hold one dumbbell with both hands above your head.
Bend your elbows to lower it behind your head.
dumbbells_on_scott_machine: Sit at the curl bench with your arms resting on the pad.
Bend your elbows to lift the weights.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight.
french_press_skullcrusher_dumbbells: Lie on a bench holding dumbbells above your chest.
Bend your elbows to lower the weights beside your head.
french_press_skullcrusher_sz_bar: Lie on a bench holding the zigzag bar above your chest.
Bend your elbows to lower it towards your forehead.
hammercurls: Stand with dumbbells at your sides, palms facing each other.
Bend your elbows to lift the weights, like holding hammers.
hammercurls_on_cable: Stand facing a low cable holding the rope, palms facing each other.
Bend your elbows to pull it up.
hand_grip: Hold the grip trainer in one hand.
Squeeze it closed as hard as you can.
Open slowly and repeat. Switch hands.
hercules_pillars: Stand between two cable machines, holding a handle in each hand.
Keep your arms out to the sides with the cables tense.
Hold the position as long as you can.
military_press_1: Stand holding a barbell at your shoulders.
Push it straight up over your head.
Lower back to your shoulders. Keep your stomach tight.
pike_push_ups: Start in a push-up position and lift your hips high, forming an upside-down V.
Bend your elbows to lower your head towards the floor.
preacher_curls: Sit at the curl bench with your arms resting on the pad, holding a bar.
Bend your elbows to lift the bar.
push_ups: Place your hands on the floor a bit wider than your shoulders, body straight.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest to the floor.
reverse_curl: Hold the weights with palms facing down.
Bend your elbows to lift them.
Lower slowly. This also works your forearms.
ring_dips: Hold the gymnastic rings and lift yourself with straight arms.
Bend your elbows to lower your body.
Push back up, keeping the rings steady.
seated_triceps_press: Sit holding a weight above your head.
Bend your elbows to lower it behind your head.
single_arm_preacher_curl: Sit at the curl bench with one arm on the pad, holding a dumbbell.
Bend your elbow to lift the weight.
smith_machine_close_grip_bench_press: Lie on a bench under the Smith machine bar, hands shoulder-width apart.
Lower the bar to your chest, elbows close to your body.
standing_rope_forearm: Hold a wrist roller (a stick with a rope and a weight) in front of you.
Twist your wrists to roll the rope up until the weight reaches the stick.
tricep_dumbbell_kickback: Lean forward with one hand on a bench, a dumbbell in the other hand.
Keep your upper arm still and straighten your elbow backwards.
Bend it again slowly. Switch arms.
triceps_bench_press_one_barbell: Lie on a bench holding a weight in one hand at shoulder level.
Push it up until your arm is straight.
triceps_dips: Hold the bars or a bench and lift yourself with straight arms.
Bend your elbows to lower your body, staying upright.
triceps_extensions_on_cable: Stand facing a high cable, holding the handle with elbows at your sides.
Push down until your arms are straight.
Let it come back up slowly.
triceps_extensions_on_cable_with_bar: Stand facing a high cable holding a straight bar.
Push the bar down until your arms are straight, elbows still.
Let it come back up slowly.
triceps_machine: Sit in the triceps machine and hold the handles.
Push them down until your arms are straight.
wall_pushup: Stand facing a wall and place your hands on it at shoulder height.
Bend your elbows to bring your chest towards the wall.
Push back. A gentle start for beginners.
z_curls: Lift dumbbells with palms up, like a normal curl.
At the top, turn your palms to face down.
Lower slowly with palms down, then turn them up again.
bent_over_barbell_row: Hold a barbell and lean forward with a flat back, knees slightly bent.
Pull the bar towards your belly, squeezing your shoulder blades.
bent_over_rowing_reverse: Lean forward with a flat back, holding the bar palms up.
bentover_dumbbell_rows: Lean forward with one hand and knee on a bench, dumbbell in the other hand.
Pull the weight up to your hip, elbow close to your body.
chin_ups: Hang from a bar with palms facing you, hands shoulder-width.
Pull yourself up until your chin passes the bar.
close_grip_lat_pull_down: Sit at the pull-down machine holding a narrow handle.
Pull it down to your chest, leaning back a little.
Let it go back up slowly.
deadlifts: Stand with the bar over your feet, bend down and grip it.
Stand up by pushing through your legs, keeping your back flat and the bar close.
Lower it back down the same way. Start light.
deficit_deadlift: Stand on a low platform with the bar in front of you.
Lift it like a normal deadlift, back flat.
Lower it with control. Harder than a normal deadlift.
hyperextensions: Lie face down on the hyperextension bench, hips on the pad.
Lower your upper body towards the floor.
Lift it back until your body is straight. Don't overarch.
incline_dumbbell_row: Lie face down on an inclined bench, a dumbbell in each hand.
Pull the weights up towards your ribs.
lat_pull_down_leaning_back: Sit at the pull-down machine holding the wide bar.
Lean back slightly and pull the bar to your upper chest.
Let it go back up slowly.
lat_pull_down_straight_back: Sit upright at the pull-down machine holding the wide bar.
Pull the bar down in front of you to your chest.
Let it go back up slowly.
leverage_machine_iso_row: Sit at the rowing machine with your chest on the pad.
Pull the handles back towards you.
Return slowly. Each arm can work on its own.
long_pulley_low_row: Sit at the low cable with feet on the platform, holding the handle.
Pull it to your belly, sitting tall.
Let your arms go forward slowly.
long_pulley_narrow: Sit at the low cable holding the narrow handle.
Pull it to your belly, elbows close to your body.
mgm_machine: Sit on the machine with your back well supported.
Push or pull the handles, keeping elbows close to your body.
muscle_up: Hang from a bar or rings.
Pull up explosively and push yourself over the bar.
Lower with control. An advanced move.
pendelay_rows: Lean forward with a flat back, the bar resting on the floor.
Pull it explosively to your lower chest.
Put it back on the floor each time.
prone_scapular_retraction_arms_at_side: Lie face down with arms out to the sides.
Lift your arms slowly, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
pull_ups_on_machine: Kneel or stand on the assisted pull-up machine.
Pull yourself up until your chin is over the bar.
Lower slowly. The machine helps you.
pull_ups: Hang from a bar with palms facing away.
Pull yourself up until your chin passes the bar.
rack_deadlift: Set the bar on supports at knee height.
Grip it and stand up straight, back flat.
Lower it back to the supports.
renegade_row: Get into a push-up position holding two dumbbells on the floor.
Pull one dumbbell up to your ribs, keeping your body still.
Put it down and switch arms.
rowing_lying_on_bench: Lie face down on a bench with weights hanging below.
Pull them up towards your chest.
rowing_seated: Sit at the rowing machine holding the handles.
Pull them back towards your belly, sitting tall.
rowing_t_bar: Stand over the T-bar, lean forward with a flat back.
Pull the handle up to your chest.
shotgun_row: Stand in a split stance holding a low cable handle in one hand.
Pull it back towards your hip, turning your palm up.
side_dumbbell_trunk_flexion: Stand holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side.
Come back up using your waist. Switch sides.
straight_arm_pull_down_bar_attachment: Stand facing a high cable holding a bar with straight arms.
Pull the bar down to your thighs, arms straight.
Let it go back up slowly.
straight_arm_pull_down_rope_attachment: Stand facing a high cable holding the rope with straight arms.
Pull it down to your thighs, arms straight.
superman: Lie face down with arms stretched in front of you.
Lift your arms, chest and legs off the floor together.
underhand_lat_pull_down: Sit at the pull-down machine holding the bar palms facing you.
Pull it down to your chest.
Let it go back up slowly.
v_bar_pulldown: Sit at the pull-down machine holding the V-shaped handle.
Pull it to your chest, elbows close to your body.
wall_slides: Stand with your back, head and arms against a wall, elbows bent.
Slide your arms up the wall without arching your back.
wide_grip_pulldown: Sit at the pull-down machine holding the bar wide.
Pull it down to your upper chest.
calf_press_using_leg_press_machine: Sit in the leg press with the balls of your feet on the bottom edge of the platform.
Push the platform by pointing your toes.
Let your heels come back slowly.
calf_raises_on_hackenschmitt_machine: Stand in the hack machine with the balls of your feet on the edge.
Rise up onto your toes, knees straight.
sitting_calf_raises: Sit in the calf machine with the pad on your knees.
Lift your heels as high as you can.
skipping_standard: Hold the rope handles, rope behind you.
Swing the rope over and jump lightly as it passes your feet.
Keep a steady rhythm on the balls of your feet.
standing_calf_raises: Stand tall, holding something for balance.
bear_walk: Get on your hands and feet, knees slightly off the floor.
Walk forward moving the opposite hand and foot together.
Keep your back flat and go steadily.
bench_press: Lie on a bench and hold the bar a little wider than your shoulders.
Lower it slowly to the middle of your chest.
Push it back up. Use a spotter for heavy weights.
benchpress_dumbbells: Lie on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand at chest height.
burpees: Stand, then squat and put your hands on the floor.
Jump your feet back into a push-up position, then jump them forward again.
Jump up with your arms overhead.
butterfly: Sit at the butterfly machine with your arms on the pads.
Bring your arms together in front of your chest.
butterfly_narrow_grip: Sit at the butterfly machine holding the handles close together.
Squeeze them together in front of you.
cable_cross_over: Stand between two high cables holding a handle in each hand.
Pull your hands down and together in front of your chest, like a hug.
cross_bench_dumbbell_pullovers: Lie across a bench holding one dumbbell above your chest.
Lower it behind your head with slightly bent arms.
Bring it back over your chest.
decline_bench_press_barbell: Lie on a decline bench (head lower) holding the bar.
Lower it to your lower chest.
decline_bench_press_dumbbell: Lie on a decline bench with dumbbells at chest height.
decline_pushups: Do a push-up with your feet up on a bench.
Lower your chest to the floor.
dips_2: Hold the parallel bars and lift yourself with straight arms.
Lean forward and bend your elbows to lower your body.
Push back up. Leaning forward works your chest.
extenseurs_face: Hold the chest expander in front of you with both hands.
Pull your arms apart, stretching the springs.
fly_with_cable: Stand between two cables holding a handle in each hand, arms open.
Bring your hands together in front of your chest.
fly_with_dumbbells: Lie on a bench holding dumbbells above your chest, elbows slightly bent.
Open your arms out to the sides in a wide arc.
Bring them back together over your chest.
fly_with_dumbbells_decline_bench: Lie on a decline bench holding dumbbells above your chest.
Open your arms in a wide arc.
incline_bench_press: Lie on an inclined bench (head higher) holding the bar.
Lower it to your upper chest.
incline_dumbbell_flye: Lie on an inclined bench with dumbbells above your chest.
Open your arms in a wide arc.
incline_dumbbell_press: Lie on an inclined bench with dumbbells at chest height.
incline_pushups: Put your hands on a bench and do a push-up.
Lower your chest to the bench.
Push back up. Easier than a floor push-up.
isometric_wipers: Start in a wide push-up position.
Shift your body over to one hand, bending that elbow.
Move across to the other side, like a windscreen wiper.
leverage_machine_chest_press: Sit at the chest press machine holding the handles.
Push them forward until your arms are straight.
pause_bench: Do a bench press, lowering the bar to your chest.
Pause for one second with the bar on your chest.
perfect_push_up: Hold the rotating push-up handles on the floor.
Lower your chest, letting the handles turn.
reverse_grip_bench_press: Lie on a bench holding the bar with palms facing you.
Lower it to your lower chest.
Push it back up. Use a spotter.
side_to_side_push_ups: Lower your chest over one hand, then push up.
Do the next one over the other hand.
upper_body: Do a circuit of push-ups, planks and arm movements.
Keep your stomach tight the whole time.
upper_external_oblique: Lie on your back, knees bent.
Lift one shoulder towards the opposite knee.
back_squat: Rest a barbell on your upper back, feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit down and back as if into a chair, knees over your toes.
Stand back up. Keep your chest up.
barbell_hack_squats: Stand with a barbell held behind your legs.
Squat down, keeping your back straight.
barbell_lunges: Stand with a barbell on your upper back.
Take a big step forward and lower your back knee towards the floor.
Push back up and switch legs.
braced_squat: Hold a weight plate straight out in front of you.
Squat down, keeping your chest up.
cycling: Get on the bike and adjust the seat to hip height.
Pedal at a steady pace you can keep.
dumbbell_goblet_squat: Hold one dumbbell against your chest with both hands.
Squat down between your knees, back straight.
dumbbell_lunges_standing: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand.
Step forward and lower your back knee towards the floor.
dumbbell_lunges_walking: Hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Step forward into a lunge, then bring the back leg forward into the next one.
front_squats: Rest the bar on the front of your shoulders.
Squat down, keeping your elbows high and chest up.
glute_bridge: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat.
Squeeze your buttocks and lift your hips.
good_mornings: Stand with a light bar on your upper back.
Bend forward from your hips with a flat back, knees slightly bent.
Come back up. Start very light.
high_knees: Run on the spot, lifting your knees to hip height.
Move your arms and keep going quickly.
hindu_squats: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, arms forward.
Squat down, rising onto your toes, swinging your arms back.
Stand up, bringing your arms forward.
hip_thrust: Sit with your upper back against a bench, a weight across your hips.
Push your hips up until your body is straight from knees to shoulders.
jumping_jacks: Stand with feet together and arms at your sides.
Jump, opening your legs and raising your arms above your head.
Jump back to the start and repeat.
kettlebell_swings: Stand with feet wide holding the kettlebell.
Push your hips back, then snap them forward to swing the weight.
Let it swing back and repeat.
leg_curls_laying: Lie face down on the machine, pad behind your ankles.
Bend your knees to bring your heels towards your buttocks.
leg_curls_sitting: Sit in the machine with the pad behind your ankles.
Bend your knees to push the pad down and back.
leg_curls_standing: Stand at the machine with the pad behind one ankle.
Bend that knee to lift your heel.
leg_extension_1: Sit in the machine with the pad on your lower shins.
Straighten your legs to lift the pad.
leg_press: Sit in the leg press with feet on the platform, shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees to bring the platform towards you.
Push it away without locking your knees.
leg_press_on_hackenschmidt_machine: Stand in the hack machine with your back on the pad.
Bend your knees to lower yourself.
leg_presses_narrow: Sit in the leg press with feet close together.
Bend your knees to lower the platform.
leg_presses_wide: Sit in the leg press with feet wide apart.
Bend your knees to lower the platform.
low_box_squat_wide_stance: Stand wide in front of a low box, bar on your back.
Sit back onto the box with control.
overhead_squat: Hold a light bar straight above your head with wide hands.
Squat down, keeping the bar above you.
Stand back up. An advanced move.
pistol_squat: Stand on one leg, the other straight in front.
Squat down on the standing leg as low as you can.
Stand back up. Use support at first.
romanian_deadlift: Stand holding a bar in front of your thighs.
Push your hips back, sliding the bar down your legs, back flat.
Come back up squeezing your buttocks.
run: Start with a gentle warm-up walk.
Run at a pace you can keep, landing lightly.
Slow down gradually at the end.
run_interval_training: Warm up for a few minutes.
Run fast for a short time, then walk or jog to recover.
run_treadmill: Step onto the treadmill and start walking.
Increase the speed to an easy run.
speed_deadlift: Lift it as fast as you can with good form.
squat_jumps: Squat down, then jump up as high as you can.
squat_thrust: Squat and place your hands on the floor.
Jump your feet back into a push-up position.
Jump them forward again and stand up.
stationary_bike: Sit on the bike and adjust the seat.
Adjust the resistance as you feel stronger.
stiff_legged_deadlifts: Stand holding a bar, knees almost straight.
Bend forward from your hips, back flat.
sumo_deadlift: Stand very wide with toes out, hands gripping the bar between your legs.
Stand up, pushing through your legs, back flat.
sumo_squats: Stand very wide with toes pointing out.
Squat down, knees following your toes.
thruster: Hold a bar or dumbbells at your shoulders.
Squat down, then stand up and push the weight over your head in one movement.
Bring it back to your shoulders.
wall_squat: Lean your back against a wall.
Slide down until your knees are bent at a right angle.
Hold as if sitting on an invisible chair.
weighted_step_ups: Hold weights in front of a box or bench.
Step up with one leg until you're standing on it.
arnold_shoulder_press: Sit holding dumbbells in front of your shoulders, palms facing you.
Push them up, turning your palms forward as you go.
Lower back, turning them in again.
bent_high_pulls: Lean forward slightly holding two dumbbells.
Pull them up to your chest, elbows high.
bent_over_lateral_raises: Lean forward with a flat back, dumbbells hanging.
Lift your arms out to the sides.
Lower slowly. This works the back of your shoulders.
butterfly_reverse: Sit facing the butterfly machine, holding the handles in front of you.
cable_external_rotation: Stand sideways to a cable, elbow at your side bent 90°.
Rotate your forearm outward, away from your body.
Return slowly. Use a light weight.
diagonal_shoulder_press: Sit on an inclined bench with the bar in front of you.
Push it up and slightly forward.
facepull: Stand facing a high cable holding a rope.
Pull it towards your face, elbows high and wide.
front_raises: Stand holding weights in front of your thighs.
Lift them straight in front of you to shoulder height.
handstand_pushup: Do a handstand against a wall.
Bend your elbows to lower your head towards the floor.
Push back up. Advanced and needs practice.
high_pull: Hold a bar in front of your thighs.
Pull it up explosively to your chest, elbows high.
lateral_raises: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides.
Lift your arms out to the sides up to shoulder height.
lateral_raises_on_cable_one_armed: Stand sideways to a low cable, holding it with the far hand.
Lift your arm out to the side up to shoulder height.
lateral_to_front_raises: Lift the weights out to the sides to shoulder height.
Bring them round to the front.
lying_rotator_cuff_exercise: Lie on your side holding a light weight, elbow bent at your side.
Lower slowly. Very light weight only.
power_clean: Stand with the bar over your feet.
Pull it up explosively and catch it on your shoulders.
Lower with control. Learn it with a coach.
push_press: Hold the bar at your shoulders.
Bend your knees slightly, then drive up and push the bar overhead.
rear_delt_raises: Lift your arms out to the sides.
shoulder_fly: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides.
Lift your arms out to the sides up to shoulder height.
shoulder_press_barbell: Sit or stand holding a bar at your shoulders.
Push it straight up over your head.
shoulder_press_dumbbells: Sit holding dumbbells at shoulder height.
Push them up over your head.
shoulder_press_on_machine: Sit at the shoulder press machine holding the handles.
shoulder_press_on_multi_press: Sit under the Smith machine bar at shoulder height.
shrugs_barbells: Stand holding a bar in front of your thighs.
Lift your shoulders towards your ears.
shrugs_dumbbells: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Lift your shoulders towards your ears.
side_lying_external_rotation: Lie on your side with a light weight, elbow bent against your waist.
snach: Stand with the bar over your feet, wide grip.
Lift it explosively from the floor straight above your head in one movement.
Lower with control. Learn it with a coach.
upright_row_w_dumbbells: Stand holding dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Pull them up along your body to chest height, elbows high.
upright_row_on_multi_press: Stand at the Smith machine holding the bar.
Pull it up to chest height, elbows high.
upright_row_sz_bar: Stand holding the zigzag bar in front of your thighs.
Pull it up to chest height, elbows high.
wall_handstand: Place your hands on the floor in front of a wall.
Kick up so your heels rest on the wall.
Hold with straight arms. Practise carefully.
